title: Appraisal Age Schedule: Annual Depreciation Rate for Equipment & Vehicle Loans Collateral in the Post-Release Test
content:
**Schedule.** The depreciation rate for the post-release test of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan is set by the average model year of the units still pledged against the calendar year of the test: 12 percent a year when that average is more than 8 years earlier, 10 percent a year when it is more than 4 but not more than 8 years earlier, and no depreciation when it is 4 years earlier or less.

## The average model year

The sum of the model years of the units still pledged (units pledged less units since released) divided by the number of those units; it may fall between two years.

## Rate by age

| Calendar year of the test less the average model year | Depreciation rate |
|---|---|
| more than 8 years | 12 percent a year |
| more than 4 but not more than 8 years | 10 percent a year |
| 4 years or less | none |

## Both sides of each line (hypothetical test in 2026)

| Average model year | Years earlier | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2018 | 8 | 10 percent |
| 2017.5 | 8.5 | 12 percent |
| 2022 | 4 | none |
| 2021.5 | 4.5 | 10 percent |
